title: [Cyrasei Lira'ka Apiary]
description: Set within the shade of a towering tanik tree is a squat fyrswn'ava alveary with rounded graduating tiers, sunlight occasionally gleaming against its celadon bands.  Moss carpets the ground in thick, springy layers, dotted with clusters of wood sorrel and creeping thyme.  Fallen leaves in amber and bronze hues rest against exposed roots that curl through the soft earth like knotted fingers.
